title: REQ · SceneObject entity renders one content object and tracks visibility
summary: SceneObject wraps one ObjectSpec with a render handle at its layer depth
description: Context: objects carry asset, position, scale, layer and visibleWhen in content. Desired behavior: SceneObject created from an ObjectSpec and a RenderContext creates one sprite at the object's position, scale and layer depth, applies visibleWhen on sync(state), and releases the handle on destroy. Expected result: entity state follows game state. Why: objects become independently managed entities.
acceptance_criteria: Given an ObjectSpec, when SceneObject is constructed, then ctx.createSprite is called once with its asset key, position, scale and layer depth
Given visibleWhen on a flag, when sync is called with the flag false then true, then the handle setVisible receives false then true
Given a constructed entity, when destroy is called, then the handle destroy is called once
definition_of_done: Entity tested with a fake RenderContext
